hypothesis: Restricting the parent gated-attention normalization to its two highest-scoring instances, with inclusive cutoff ties, may reduce background dilution while retaining the parent's encoder, attention learning, and classifier capacity. This is a known sparse-attention control, not an algorithmic novelty claim. Any benefit must appear in paired discrimination under both clean and corrupted bag labels; invariance is conditional on added background staying below the selection cutoff.
implementation_plan: Treat this bundle as a deferred candidate specification: the brief's two host-evaluation limit has been reached. Do not schedule a third evaluation without an explicit campaign-budget revision.

If execution is separately authorized, edit only program_1/src/program.py starting from the selected root parent. Preserve module definitions, declaration order, width 32, initialization, learning-rate default, and label-smoothing default.

Keep the parent's features and gated attention scores. Compute cutoff = scores.topk(2, dim=1).values[:, -1:] and retained = scores >= cutoff. Use weights = torch.softmax(scores.masked_fill(~retained, float('-inf')), dim=1).

Keep pooled = (weights.unsqueeze(-1) * features).sum(dim=1) and the original classifier output. Inclusive ties can retain more than two instances; this is deliberate and avoids order-dependent cutoff selection.
Use bag supervision only. Add no auxiliary losses, buffers derived from data, label-dependent logic, training loops, or diagnostics. Add no parameters.

If a revised budget permits evaluation, return the candidate for one host-owned evaluation. Obtain both AUROCs, positive-score change, runtime, actual steps, and parameter count from host records only; retain negative results and keep holdout frozen.

research_basis.alternative_explanation: Learned attention may select background extremes rather than lesion evidence. Sparse gradients may impair fitting or amplify bag-label noise. Handcrafted features may lack tumor information. Any observed gain can also reflect optimization or regularization rather than reduced dilution.

closest_work.difference: Restricts normalization support by a fixed second-score cutoff while preserving the parent network. The controlled paired background addition is a pilot evaluation setting, not evidence of algorithmic novelty.
closest_work.overlap: Uses the supplied paper's gated, normalized attention pooling and bag-level supervision; method equations 7-9 in the saved full text were inspected.

closest_work.difference: Uses jointly learned attention scores and fixed-count support rather than a CUR-derived negative-instance key bank, cosine-similarity saliency, and percentage selection. This is a simpler control, not a claimed improvement over SiiMIL.
closest_work.overlap: Selects salient instances before attention-based classification to address minority lesion evidence; saved full-text sections 3.4.3 and 3.5 were inspected.

closest_work.difference: Changes pooling only, with no pseudo-bag division, cross-bag mixing, or target mixing. Fixed symmetric bag-label flips remain evaluator-owned.
closest_work.overlap: Related work ranks attention scores and drops low-ranked instances; label-noise robustness is a shared evaluation concern. Saved full-text method overview and related augmentation section were inspected.

research_basis.contribution: A controlled sparse-attention pooling comparison on fixed-feature synthetic pathology bags, preserving active parent capacity. The contribution is the controlled pilot measurement, not a new selection algorithm. No novelty distinction is asserted against unavailable rank-induction or IBMIL full texts.
research_basis.discriminating_test: Under a separately revised evaluation budget, compare the frozen parent and this aggregation-only candidate using the host's paired 16/64-bag AUROCs in each label-noise condition and positive-score change. Better worst-length discrimination together with a smaller paired decline is consistent with reduced dilution. Positive-score stability without better discrimination is insufficient. Clean-only gains support sensitivity to label noise. Available aggregate metrics cannot prove that selected instances are tumors or fully separate optimization from dilution; do not request patch labels or internal diagnostics.

target_rubrics.description: Normalize gated attention only over scores at or above the second largest score. Retain all cutoff ties to preserve permutation invariance for bags of length 16 and 64.
Keep the width-32 parent encoder, both attention branches, attention projection, and classifier active in the forward path. Preserve constructor order and defaults; change aggregation only.
